package fixture

// Data for TestPurityRecordsSelectorsSelfTest. A line ending in "want" is flagged
// in every class; a line ending in "want:non-rttype" is flagged in every class
// except recordtypes/<type> (the only one that may call SetValidator, in init).

import (
	rec "github.com/rbenzing/minutiae/internal/records"
)

var _ rec.Record
var _ rec.Range
var _ rec.Time
var _ rec.NamedTime
var _ rec.Basis = rec.BasisUTC
var _ = rec.BasisLocalOffset
var _ = rec.BasisLocalUnknown

func use(r rec.Record) rec.Record {
	_ = rec.NewWriter        // want
	_ = rec.NewReader        // want
	_ = rec.RegisterType     // want
	_ = rec.Prepare          // want
	_ = rec.Parser{}         // want
	_ = rec.Types()          // want
	_ = rec.LookupType("x")  // want
	_ = rec.AlreadyIngested  // want
	_ = rec.ErrInvalidRecord // want
	_ = rec.WriterOptions{}  // want
	_ = rec.ReadHandle       // want
	rec.SetValidator("message", nil) // want
	return r
}

func init() {
	rec.SetValidator("message", nil) // want:non-rttype
	f := func() {
		rec.SetValidator("later", nil) // want
	}
	_ = f
	defer func() { rec.SetValidator("deferred", nil) }() // want
}

type holder struct{}

func (holder) init() {
	rec.SetValidator("method", nil) // want
}

var _ = rec.SetValidator // want
